const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual, proprioception-only controller for the live RoboCasa365 episode.
+
+The service is the only simulator interface. `pixel_world` reconstructs points
+from returned RGB-D and the calibration bundled with that observation. Arm
+motions use the published joint targets plus an experimentally estimated local
+end-effector Jacobian from proprioceptive readings.
+"""
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+dt = float(spec["control_dt"])
+camera = "robot0_agentview_right"
+
+def observe(cameras=None, depth=False):
+    return r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or [camera], include_depth=depth, video="none")
+
+def state(result=None):
+    if result is None:
+        result = observe(cameras=[])
+    p = np.asarray(result.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    return p, p[4:11].copy(), p[26:29].copy()
+
+def action_row(q, grip=-1.0, base=(0., 0., 0.), torso=0., mode=-1.):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(q, dtype=float), grip, base, torso, mode]
+
+def move_joints(q_goal, seconds=1.0, grip=-1.0, cameras=None, note="arm move"):
+    p, q0, _ = state()
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / dt)))
+    qs = np.linspace(q0, np.asarray(q_goal, dtype=float), n)
+    acts = np.stack([action_row(q, grip=grip) for q in qs])
+    return r.submit("joint_position", acts, cameras=cameras or [camera], video="none", note=note)
+
+def pixel_world(obs, cam, u, v):
+    """Unproject one observed pixel using only the response's depth/calibration."""
+    z = float(np.asarray(obs.depth[cam])[0, int(v), int(u)])
+    meta = obs.meta["cameras"][cam]
+    K = np.asarray(meta["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(meta["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+    cam_gl = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1], -z, 1.])
+    return (T @ cam_gl)[:3], z
+
+def estimate_jacobian(eps=0.025, steps=5, joints=range(6)):
+    """Measure d(EEF world XYZ)/d(joint) with small reversible joint motions."""
+    _, q, e0 = state()
+    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
+    for j in joints:
+        pert = q.copy(); pert[j] += eps
+        a = np.tile(action_row(pert), (steps, 1))
+        o1 = r.submit("joint_position", a, cameras=[], video="none", note=f"Jacobian probe j{j+1}")
+        e1 = state(o1)[2]
+        back = np.tile(action_row(q), (steps, 1))
+        o2 = r.submit("joint_position", back, cameras=[], video="none", note="return Jacobian probe")
+        q = state(o2)[1]
+        J[:, j] = (e1 - e0) / eps
+        e0 = state(o2)[2]
+    return J
+
+def cartesian_step(delta_xyz, J, seconds=1.0, grip=-1.0, note="visual Cartesian step"):
+    """Damped least-squares local Cartesian move; caller replans from new RGB-D."""
+    _, q, _ = state()
+    d = np.asarray(delta_xyz, dtype=float)
+    dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + 0.0004*np.eye(3), d)
+    # Keep each update local so an old Jacobian is not extrapolated too far.
+    scale = min(1.0, 0.18 / max(1e-9, float(np.max(np.abs(dq)))))
+    return move_joints(q + scale*dq, seconds=seconds, grip=grip, note=note)
+
+def open_gripper(q=None, seconds=.3, cameras=None):
+    if q is None: _, q, _ = state()
+    n=max(1,int(round(seconds/dt)))
+    acts=np.tile(action_row(q, grip=-1.), (n,1))
+    return r.submit("joint_position", acts, cameras=cameras or [camera], video="none", note="release gripper")
+
+print("Connected", spec.get("protocol"), "control_dt", dt, "time left", r.status().get("time_left_s"))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

const r = await tools.write_stdin({session_id:78380,chars:"o=observe([camera],True)\nprint('state',state(o)[2],state(o)[1]); print('sample',[(xy,pixel_world(o,camera,*xy)) for xy in [(210,50),(213,52),(213,60),(213,65)]])\n",yield_time_ms:1000,max_output_tokens:1000});
